description.text: The durations of short-term Chinese training programs are 2 to 6 weeks, focusing on developing speaking skill, and the college does not stipulate students' Chinese proficiency level. The Chinese language classes are taken in the morning on weekdays, for a total of 20 hours per week. In the afternoon school delivers lectures on Chinese culture and society (Chinese Gongfu and Chinese painting etc) and historical site visits will be arranged on weekends. For groups of 10-15 students, application shall begin at least 1 month in advance. Schedule for the Chinese language training is as follows: Schedule Week Morning (8:10-11:35) Afternoon (14:00-16:00) The first week Monday Opening ceremony & Welcome Banquet Tuesday Chinese courses Chinese knot Wednesday Chinese courses Chinese gongfu Thursday Chinese courses Symposium Friday Chinese courses Free time Saturday The Great Wall Sunday Capital Museum About Beijing Union University Accommodation Beijing Union University International Student Residence is reserved for long-term and short-term international students studying at School of International Education of BUU. Two buildings are available for international students: Building C and Building D. There are 107 Standard Rooms with 208 beds. All rooms are designed and furnished at the standard of 3 or 4 star hotel. Besides, we also provide favorable price and high-standard service to our students. All rooms are equipped with air conditioner、television、telephone and private bathroom so as to provide reasonable comfort for the occupants and facilitate tidiness. Building C and Building D Introductions Standard Room: air conditioner, television, telephone and private bathroom All rooms are designed and furnished at the standard of 3 or 4 star hotel. Hostel reservations about accepting applications for a specific time please contact directly with Beijing Union University. Application Applicants who plan to live in International Students’ Residence should make reservation in advance by filling in International Students Residence Form. Payment 1）Single Room RMB80/day/per person （Private Bathroom，12 sq.m） 2）Standard Room RMB60/day/per person（Private Bathroom， 20 sq.m） 3）Standard Room RMB50day/per person（Private Bathroom， 15 sq.m） 4）Standard Room RMB45/day/per person（Private Bathroom， 13 sq.m） 5）Standard Room RMB35/day/per person（Public Bathroom，13 sq.m） Fees Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 97 USD/per week ￥ 700 CNY/per week Admissions Process 3 Steps to Apply to a Chinese University 1 Choose Programs 2 Apply Online 3 ENROLL IN CHINA Entry Requirements Application Materials Reviews 8.9 (0 Reviews) Write a review Location Location Recommend a friend?
